source.title: Bitcoin and Election Day 2026 | BMTV Nov. 3, 2026
source.description:

Guests:
Mason Lynaugh — Executive Director, Stand With Crypto

And of course, another big story is election day today with control of Congress up for grabs and potential implications for taxes, regulations, and government.

So let's go over to the bond market now.
The 10 -year yield up to basis points on the day, trading at 4.93%.
And looking at the entire curve here, the three -month yield at 413, the 5 -year at 471, and the 30 -year at 529.
Gold under pressure this morning down 3 tenths of a percent, trading at $3,941 per ounce.
And finally, oil.
WTI trading in the mid -90 range at 9620 with Brent crude just over 100 at about 103.
Sean, what do you what are you looking at this morning?
I'd like to see oil continue to trade down.
I think that obviously there's been a lot of tension building up to the midterms, especially with the Iran situation.
Obviously, they do not want President Trump in office.
He's now kicked them out of the world.
Economic order twice now in both of his terms.
So now that we're kind of getting past that phase, hopefully we can get some sort of resolution there in the energy markets.
Obviously, that's not going to alleviate.
what we see with crack spreads for refined products due to the loss of several refineries.
I'm also going to be watching Apple and Palantir today to see how they trade post earnings.
But again, Bitcoin looking incredibly strong right now.
We've come back down where we're a much closer to our 50 week moving average than we have been in several weeks.
This has now been our seventh weekly close just above that 50 week moving average.

I'd like to see continued resilience here as we see selloffs in the broader equity market to show us put in our eighth consecutive week above that 50 week would be really, really good news and a continued sign of momentum that.
This bull market is truly here, and this isn't some sort of, you know, bull trap shakeout.
But of course, we've yet to actually come down and properly test that line yet.
Right now, it's actually down closer to 75.
Last time we talked to is up just a hair above 76.
You know, each weekly close that we trade at these levels, if we continue to fall down, it actually kind of has this push -down effect as well.
Again, better to test it now than to test it in January when it's going to be even lower.
